evaluations.evidence: As a moderator, I want to create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible permission, behavior, constraint, state, or rule with creating a game and providing name/description.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids or contradicts inviting via URL; compatible with join-by-URL story.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: No other story imposes an incompatible requirement on how rounds are started or items entered.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: No other story prohibits showing the list of items; consistent with participant stories asking to view items.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: No story imposes a conflicting constraint on selecting items for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids adding items during a session; compatible with editing/deleting items.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items does not conflict with other stories; no incompatible rules found.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deletion of items is not contradicted by other stories; consistent with deleting games/accounts separately.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This permits revealing estimates before all estimators have responded, which is incompatible with PP-033 that requires estimates to be shown only after all estimators have given their estimate.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: No other story forbids accepting an average; this is a compatible moderator action.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automatic filling when all cards match does not contradict other stories; it does not force revealing estimates earlier than required.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of agreed estimate is compatible with other acceptance/estimation stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating earlier stories does not conflict with other rules; no incompatible constraints found.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is not contradicted by any story; no incompatible behavior identified.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste import is compatible with other backlog items; no conflicting constraint present.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games does not conflict with delete actions (which specify removing games when requested); not inherently incompatible.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is compatible with export and delete functionality; no conflicting requirement detected.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts is compatible with viewing/export stories and not contradicted elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export is not incompatible with any other story; compatible with data handling constraints (privacy not forbidding exports).

evaluations.evidence: delete a game, so that stories and estimates for this game are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Deleting games is consistent with account deletion and browsing; no story requires deleted games to remain stored.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation does not conflict with other stories; no incompatible permissions or states are imposed elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login requirement is not imposed to contradict other stories (e.g., joining by URL); no explicit conflict exists in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Updating account details is not incompatible with other stories; no conflicting rule present.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion removing account info and games is consistent with delete game story; no contradictory story requires retained data after deletion.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display preference does not conflict with any other story's behaviors or rules.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder by email does not conflict with other authentication stories.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting number sequences for cards is not contradicted by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: A limit of up to 15 is not contradicted by any other story specifying incompatible limits.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Allowing estimators to join via URL/name does not conflict with account stories; no other story requires different joining behaviour.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Showing the current item is compatible with moderator and participant stories; no conflicting constraint found.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Participant viewing of item list matches moderator stories and doesn't conflict with them.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: This indicates who has submitted without revealing values; it doesn't conflict with the requirement to reveal values simultaneously after all estimates (PP-033), as it is a different, non-revealing indicator.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This requires that estimates are revealed only after all have responded, which is incompatible with PP-009 that allows the moderator to show estimates immediately before all responses are in.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Allowing changes until reveal is compatible with other stories; no contradictory rule found (except the general conflict between moderator immediate-show and participant reveal timing already identified).

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is historical and does not contradict any story requiring anonymity of stored research data (which can be anonymized separately).

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing identities during the round is compatible with storage-anonymization requirements and other interactive rules; no direct contradiction in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer functionality does not conflict with other stories; no incompatible behavior identified.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Auto-reset on all-play is consistent with timer and round behavior; no conflicting rules found.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Browsing prior rounds is compatible with transcripts and export stories; not incompatible with privacy requirements as storage can be anonymized.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering consistency does not conflict with any other story.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This is consistent with other change/until-reveal stories and imposes no incompatible rule.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying thumbnail photos during gameplay does not conflict with other stories; privacy/storage requirements can be addressed separately.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance does not conflict with any other backlog items.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing definitions does not impose rules incompatible with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes, so that the queries run as fast as possible
evaluations.rationale: Performance-focused developer task does not conflict with functional or privacy stories.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility requirement does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is not at odds with any other requirement.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance expectation does not conflict with other functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL predictability requirement is compatible with other stories; no incompatible rules found.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page quality does not conflict with other stories.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Storing research results non-identifiably is compatible with in-session visibility of identities if storage anonymizes data; no explicit contradictory story requires identifiable storage.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Collecting metrics can be implemented non-identifiably and does not inherently conflict with privacy or other stories.
